newEntry.name: Spin & Skein
newEntry.desc: Snip twelve runners and cross two whorl arms on a gravity-seated shaft for a knock-down yarn spindle. Measured sheet/socket reference, calibrated indexing and local PNG/JPEG/SVG relief or verified ASCII/binary STL shaft marks; connected-card, clean-part STL and assembly ZIP. Yarn required; slow finger-spin only, no positive retention or physical print test.
